text:
zoe (pm): Quick sync: proposing a Compact Commit + Add-on bundle. Goal: simple mid-tier for startups — small monthly commit that unlocks predictable routing + optional add-on packs (priority tokens, regional routing). Wanted a quick feasibility/contract check.

cedric (sales): Customers asked for something exactly like this. Keep it simple: one monthly commit SKU + optional packs. Pilot customers will want a trial pack.

hana (eng): Technical: map commit to routing weight + token bucket. Easy to do tenant-level. Need accounting hooks and burn telemetry. Estimate 2 sprints for pilot.

maria (finance): Pricing idea: commit $149/mo (includes 100k tokens), priority pack $199/250k tokens, regional add-on +$250/mo. I'll run margin sims.

ira (legal): Need contract language: definitions for "commit", overage calc, and right to alter routing for safety. Also data residency clause if regional add-on sold. I'll draft short addendum.

lee (ops): Ops: can do prioritized queue for pilot (no hard reserve). If we promise stronger SLAs later, we'll need committed capacity. For pilot we'll scope US-only. Need QPS from sales.

pat (devex): SDK: tenant flag + per-request override header. I'll prepare quickstart and an eval harness to check quality delta between commit path vs default.

zoe (pm): Launch criteria proposal: 1) router + accounting in staging, 2) docs + quickstart, 3) 3 pilot customers, 4) finance models + legal addendum. Owners: zoe (PM), hana (eng), cedric (sales), maria (finance), ira (legal), lee (ops), pat (devex).

cedric (sales): I'll recruit pilots and collect traffic windows this week. Prefer 1 mid-market + 2 startups.

maria (finance): I'll share sensitivity model by Tue; free trial pack ok for pilot.

hana (eng): Confirmed 2 sprint estimate if US-only and tenant-level only.

ira (legal): Will post redlines by tomorrow. Add data residency clause if regional add-on requested.

lee (ops): Will provision priority queue in us-west-2 for pilot; need QPS numbers.

pat (devex): Will draft quickstart + sample eval prompts and link in MRD.

zoe (pm): Locking kickoff Wed 9am PT unless someone objects. Speak now. :thumbsup:
